color_conversion: OpenCV Lab from the saved RGB camera image
runtime_policy: Fixed appearance reference; runtime observations cannot adapt the floor color model. At least 24 calibrated-looking low-gradient pixels and one contiguous calibrated floor component of at least 4000 pixels must be visible or the frame is invalid/UNKNOWN.
scope_limit: Calibration is specific to the simulated floor material, lighting, camera response, provisional camera transform, and Phase 3 capture; it is not a universal floor detector.
